ranch: Miller & Lux (Fresno County / Los Banos, San Joaquin Valley)
note: Miller & Lux was a corporate cattle-and-land empire headquartered at Los Banos (Merced County) with core San Joaquin Valley holdings across Fresno, Merced, Madera, Stanislaus, plus major Kern County lands (Buena Vista / Kern River, subject of Lux v. Haggin) and Rancho lands in Monterey/San Benito/San Luis Obispo. Henry Miller's personal 'home ranch' Bloomfield was near Gilroy in SANTA CLARA County (Rancho Las Animas) and his Mt. Madonna homes are also Santa Clara -- these are flagged separately and are NOT the San Joaquin Valley cattle operation. Archival collections are catalogued under the family names (Henry Miller / Charles Lux) and the corporate name 'Miller & Lux', not by modern place names.
